requirement: The `habeas` skill's reference on distributed requirements MUST give the guidance of {cite}`requirements.cli.distributed_guidance.when`, {cite}`requirements.cli.distributed_guidance.queries`, {cite}`requirements.cli.distributed_guidance.site_text`, and {cite}`requirements.cli.distributed_guidance.reviews` as a list of things to do and a list of things not to do.
rationale:
The test `tests/authoring_cli.rs#fn[bundled_skills_give_distributed_guidance_as_do_and_dont_lists]` adequately checks `requirements.cli.distributed_guidance.lists`.

**Obligation.** The `habeas` skill's distributed-requirements reference (`assets/skills/habeas/references/distributed-requirements.md`) must give the guidance of `when`, `queries`, `site_text` and `reviews` as a list of things to do and a list of things not to do.

**Structure.**
- The test finds the `## Do` and `## Don't` sections in the raw reference file. `unwrap` makes it fail if either is missing.
- For each section it collects the top-level `- ` bullets and asserts there are at least two.
- Every `## Do` bullet must start with `- ` and must not start with `- Don't `.
- Every `## Don't` bullet must start with `- Don't `.
- Together these assertions make the first list a Do list and the second a Don't list. A bullet in the wrong list would fail.

**Content placement.** `assert_text` runs over the collapsed `section(...)` body of each list. It requires phrases for each of the four cited requirements to sit in the right list:
- `when`: the Do bullet "Make a requirement distributed only when…" and the Do bullet "Separate obligations each site upholds…". These cover the distributed-only-when guidance and marking `{impl}` on code that carries out obligations the sites don't uphold.
- `queries`: the Do bullets "Write a violation query" and "Give every query `match` and `no_match` snippets". It also checks the sentence about checking that the site queries select every place the obligation applies and no others.
- `site_text`: the Do bullet "Describe sites exactly as the site queries select them", plus the Don't bullets "Don't describe sites more broadly" and "Don't state a per-site obligation".
- `reviews`: the Do bullet "Let `habeas author --all` author the site reviews." and the Don't bullets "Don't reference the distributed requirement from a site" and "Don't re-run a false site review for a different result".

I read the reference file and confirmed that its `## Do` and `## Don't` sections contain these bullets, so the expected results are correct. The helpers `section`, `assert_text` and `distributed_reference` are reached from the marked test and need no reference of their own.

**Residual points.**
- This requirement is about the list form. Whether each piece of guidance says the right thing is covered by the refining requirements' own tests, such as `bundled_skills_make_a_requirement_distributed_only_for_per_site_obligations`, `bundled_skills_explain_site_references_and_site_reviews` and the others that use `section(distributed_reference(), "## Do")` and `"## Don't"`. Those obligations need no test here.
- Some detail inside a bullet is not asserted here. One example is the `{impl}` clause of the "Make a requirement distributed only when" bullet. The test still verifies that the guidance sits in the Do list, and the content tests cover the text.

I found no gap that is not already covered, and there are no acknowledgments to consider.

text: The `habeas` skill's reference on distributed requirements MUST give the guidance of {cite}`requirements.cli.distributed_guidance.when`, {cite}`requirements.cli.distributed_guidance.queries`, {cite}`requirements.cli.distributed_guidance.site_text`, and {cite}`requirements.cli.distributed_guidance.reviews` as a list of things to do and a list of things not to do.

The bundled skills MUST direct agents to make a requirement distributed only when its obligation applies on its own at each of many sites, such as a convention every validation function follows; to use `{impl}` instead when particular code carries out the requirement as a whole; and to mark with `{impl}` the code that carries out any obligation of a distributed requirement that its sites do not uphold.

The bundled skills MUST direct agents to write site queries that select every place the obligation applies and no others, violation queries for every kind of construct that could break it, and, for every query, `match` and `no_match` snippets that test its conditions.

The bundled skills MUST direct agents to describe sites exactly as the site queries select them, to state as an obligation any convention the queries rely on, such as how a list is named, and to state only per-site obligations that a reviewer can check from the site and the helpers it calls.

The bundled skills MUST tell agents that sites need no reference to the requirement, that `habeas author --all` authors site reviews under {cite}`requirements.references.site_review`, and that a false site review is addressed by fixing the site, or by tightening the queries or the requirement text when the site should not be covered or the text admits more than one reading, under {cite}`requirements.cli.flip_guidance`, not by re-running the review.
